sections.title: How it works for the client

badge.text: How it works for the client

items.title: PWA Access
items.text: The client opens their personal PWA app (installed via QR code)

items.title: Appointments Menu
items.text: Clicks on "Request Appointment" from the main menu

items.title: Service Selection
items.text: Chooses the desired treatment from the list

items.title: Staff Preference
items: Can choose a preferred staff member from the dropdown menu
Or leave "No preference" for automatic assignment

items.title: Date and Time
items.text: Selects the date and desired time slot

items.title: Submit Request
items.text: Clicks "Submit Request" - the request arrives in your "Booking Requests" section

items.title: Receive notification
items.text: View the request with all details (client, service, date, time, staff preference)

items.title: Automatic Confirmation
items: Click "Approve" for quick confirmation
The system automatically assigns the preferred staff member (if available) or an available one
Automatically assigns the first available room

items.title: Manual Confirmation
items: A dialog opens with selection options
You can manually choose staff member and room
Useful for optimizing organization or handling special preferences

items.title: Client Notification
items.text: The client receives appointment confirmation with complete details (assigned staff member and room)

items.title: 📅 View Appointments
items: Complete list of all appointments (past and future)
Details: date, time, service, assigned staff member, room
Appointment status (confirmed, completed, cancelled)
Real-time updates

items.title: 📄 Documents and Invoices
items: Access to all issued invoices
PDF download directly from the app
Complete payment history

items.title: 📞 Direct Contacts
items: 📧 Email: Tap to open email client with pre-filled address
📱 Phone: Tap to call the practice directly
🌐 Website: Direct link to your website
📷 Instagram: Open Instagram profile
👍 Facebook: Link to Facebook page

items.title: 🔔 Push Notifications
items: Automatic appointment reminders
Booking confirmations
Important updates from the practice

items.title: 📱 Works Offline
items: Access to data even without connection
Automatic synchronization when back online

items.title: No Store Download
items.text: Instant installation via QR code, without going through App Store or Google Play

items.title: Always Updated
items.text: Automatic updates without needing to install new versions

items.title: Personalized
items.text: Each client sees only their data (appointments, invoices, documents)

items.title: Custom Icon
items.text: The app displays your practice logo on the phone's home screen

items.title: Quick Access
items.text: One tap on the icon and the client is in their personal area

items.title: Multi-Platform
items.text: Works on iPhone, Android, tablet and desktop

items.title: Secure
items.text: Authentication via unique token, no password to remember

items.title: Direct Contact
items.text: Email, phone and social networks at your fingertips

tips.proTip: Show clients how to install the app during their first visit. They will immediately see the added value and feel more engaged in their relationship with your practice!
tips.retention: The personalized PWA app creates a stronger bond with clients, increasing retention and reducing no-shows thanks to automatic reminders and the premium user experience.
